entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may support A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both.

entities.name: R99 QoS Parameter Values
entities.description: The corresponding R99 QoS parameter values of a PDP context that shall be included by the network.

entities.name: PDP Context
entities.description: Packet Data Protocol context for which R99 QoS parameters are negotiated.

relations.description: The network shall include the corresponding R99 QoS parameter values.
R99 QoS parameter values are associated with a PDP context.
Network behavior is conditional on UE support for A/Gb mode or Iu mode.
